pipeline.target: TMPRSS6 (raises hepcidin, lowers iron availability for RBC production)

indications.trial_design: Phase 1/2 study evaluating SLN124 (divesiran) in PV patients; Phase 2 portion testing Q6W and Q12W subcutaneous dosing for HCT control and phlebotomy reduction. Fully enrolled.
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (fully enrolled). Topline Phase 2 results anticipated Q3 2026. FDA Fast Track and Orphan Drug designations granted; EMA orphan designation also granted.
key_milestones: Phase 1 readout: durable HCT control, reduced phlebotomy on Q6W dosing in 21 patients

indications.indication: Cardiovascular disease in patients with elevated lipoprotein(a) (Lp(a))
indications.trial_name: Phase 3 cardiovascular outcomes trial (CVOT) — name not yet disclosed
indications.trial_design: Planned Phase 3 cardiovascular outcomes trial in patients with high Lp(a); FDA and EMA have provided positive feedback on study design; manufacturing and supply scale-up completed in 2025.
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — Zerlasiran is 'Phase 3 ready'; Silence is seeking a third-party partner for Phase 3 development and commercialization. Phase 1 APOLLO and Phase 2 ALPACAR-360 (NCT05537571, NCT04606602) both COMPLETED with up to ~98% Lp(a) reduction; no active Phase 3 trial yet initiated.
key_milestones: APOLLO Phase 1 single + multiple ascending dose: up to 98% Lp(a) reduction
ALPACAR-360 Phase 2 (n=178): >80% time-averaged placebo-adjusted Lp(a) reduction over 36 weeks, durable to 60 weeks

excluded_preclinical.stage: Phase 1 ready (preclinical); seeking third-party partner to initiate clinical development

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Legacy program; not in current pipeline

excluded_partner_owned.note: Trial run by AstraZeneca; on March 4, 2026 AstraZeneca notified Silence it will not pursue further development beyond Phase 1. Silence will regain global rights following Phase 1 completion. Currently not Silence-sponsored.

blockers: Zerlasiran Phase 3 not yet initiated — listed as PLANNED pending partner; if strict 'active enrollment only' is applied, Phase 3 count becomes 0.
